'''Overload Couplings''' were components used in [[planetary ion cannon]]s, such as [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards']] [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|v-150 Planet Defender]]. The couplings were located in the base of the weapon, between the [[energy converter]] and [[Power conduit/Legends|power conduits]].<ref name="EGWT" />
